import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os

# Set environment paths
input_path = "./input"
sub_path = "./submission"
os.makedirs(sub_path, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_path}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_path}/test.csv")
sample_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_path}/sample_submission.csv")

# Get species list from sample submission header
y_classes = [col for col in sample_df.columns if col != "id"]
print(f"Number of species classes: {len(y_classes)}")

# Feature columns are all non-ID columns
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != "id"]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_df["species"].values

# Map species names to indices
y_dict = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(y_classes)}
inv_y_dict = {idx: name for idx, name in y_dict.items()}
total_classes = len(y_classes)


# Function to clip probabilities safely per spec
def clip_probs(probs):
    return np.clip(probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)


# Function to calculate Log Loss (multi-class)
def calc_log_loss(y_true_one_hot, y_pred_prob):
    N = y_true_one_hot.shape[0]
    pred_safe = np.clip(y_pred_prob, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    loss = -np.sum(y_true_one_hot * np.log(pred_safe)) / N
    return float(loss)


# Split Training Data into Train and Hold-Out (NOT to be used during training!)
# Use stratified split for better class balance
X_train_final, X_holdout, y_train_final, y_holdout_str = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.3, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Initialize LabelEncoder
le = None
for _ in range(len(X_train_final)):
    # Just placeholder - we need to fit properly
    break

# Convert strings to integers for modeling
y_train_int = np.array([y_dict[label] for label in y_train])
y_holdout_int = np.array([y_dict[label] for label in y_holdout_str])

model = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0, penalty="l2", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, multi_class="multinomial"
)
model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_int)

# --- VALIDATION METRIC COMPUTATION ON TRUE HOLDOUT ---
y_holdout_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_holdout)
y_holdout_pred_norm = np.array([row / row.sum() for row in y_holdout_pred_prob])
y_holdout_pred_norm = clip_probs(y_holdout_pred_norm)

# Create one-hot encoded true labels for validation using SPECIES NAMES
y_holdout_one_hot = np.zeros((len(y_holdout_str), total_classes))
for i, label in enumerate(y_holdout_str):
    idx = y_dict[label]
    y_holdout_one_hot[i, idx] = 1.0

val_logloss = calc_log_loss(y_holdout_one_hot, y_holdout_pred_norm)
print(f"{val_logloss:.6f}")

# --- TEST SET PREDICTIONS ---
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
y_test_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)
y_test_pred_norm = np.array([row / row.sum() for row in y_test_pred_prob])
y_test_pred_norm = clip_probs(y_test_pred_norm)

# --- PREPARE SUBMISSION FILE --- (EXACT FORMAT FROM SAMPLE)
submission_cols = ["id"] + y_classes
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(index=test_df["id"].values)
submission_df.columns = submission_cols
submission_df[y_classes] = y_test_pred_norm

# Save submission to ./submission/submission.csv
submission_df.to_csv(f"{sub_path}/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully!")
